children: On Friday, Sen.
Thom Tillis
(R-N.C.) reportedly placed a hold on
Michael LoSapio
, President
Donald Trump
’s nominee to lead the nation’s cyber defense agency, over LoSapio’s denial that the Jan. 6, 2021, Capitol breach was an attack.
The hold on LoSapio’s nomination to lead the Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) means Senate Majority Leader
John Thune
(R-S.D.) will not include him in a package of nominees to be voted on in December, a senior GOP aide told HuffPost.
HuffPost reported that Tillis also placed a hold within the past day on
Eric Ueland
, Trump’s pick to head the Government Accountability Office. According to the report, some lawmakers in both parties have called Ueland too partisan for the independent watchdog role.
The office of Thom Tillis did not immediately respond to
request for comment.
Palantir Executive Faces Jan. 6 Question at Hearing
LoSapio is chief information security officer at
Palantir Technologies Inc.
. Palantir is a tech firm founded by
Peter Thiel
JD Vance
At a Thursday confirmation hearing, Sen.
Richard Blumenthal
(D-Conn.) asked LoSapio, "Was there an attack on the Capitol of January 6, 2021?" On that day, a mob of
to try to overturn Joe Biden’s 2020 election victory.
He first said, "I don’t know." He then said, "No, I don’t believe it was an attack."
Tillis, who is not seeking re-election, told The Hill the question is not open to debate. "It’s binary," he said. He added that pretending the attack did not happen shows a lack of thoughtfulness.
Why CISA Leadership Matters for Election and Cyber Security
CISA helps protect U.S. election infrastructure from hacking. A week after the 2020 election, it joined other agencies in calling that vote "the most secure in American history."
Trump has disputed that conclusion. In an April 2025 memorandum, he accused
Chris Krebs
, who led CISA in 2020, of "falsely and baselessly" denying the election was rigged.
On Thursday, the White House
National Cyber Director
Sean Cairncross
and named Pentagon technology chief
Kirsten Davies
as acting replacement after outages across U.S. aviation, banking and intelligence networks.

title: Trump’s Cybersecurity Agency Pick Faces Senate Roadblock After Thom Tillis Blocks Nomination Over Capitol ‘Attack’ Denial
